name: Service and TLS event counts
description: System Event counts for 7022, 7031, 7032, 36873 and 36874 with per-event last-seen timestamps. A zero means no matching events among observed System telemetry, not proof of complete collection.
kql:
Event
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where EventLog == 'System'
| summarize SystemEventObservations = count(), Event7022 = countif(EventID == 7022), Last7022 = maxif(TimeGenerated, EventID == 7022), Event7031 = countif(EventID == 7031), Last7031 = maxif(TimeGenerated, EventID == 7031), Event7032 = countif(EventID == 7032), Last7032 = maxif(TimeGenerated, EventID == 7032), Event36873 = countif(EventID == 36873), Last36873 = maxif(TimeGenerated, EventID == 36873), Event36874 = countif(EventID == 36874), Last36874 = maxif(TimeGenerated, EventID == 36874) by Computer
| order by Computer asc
